title: EVM-Anchored Provenance for AI-Assisted Code Evolution: A Smoke-Scale Deployment Report
abstract: arXiv:2610.33350v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We report a smoke-scale deployment of an EVM-anchored provenance framework for the state stream produced by AI-assisted code generation. The system comprises codebase-state-manager, an open-source Model Context Protocol (MCP) server (MIT, v0.2.1) that exposes codebase state, transition, and reward operations to any MCP-compatible assistant, and CodebaseStateRegistry, a Solidity contract deployed on Base Sepolia that emits per-state commitment events. Payloads are pinned to the InterPlanetary File System (IPFS) and indexed through a rebuildable SQLite mirror that resynchronizes by replaying contract events. We delimit precisely what anchoring does and does not attest (existence, ordering, and non-equivocation by the committer key; never truthfulness or fabrication-prevention) and outline the orthogonal supply-chain controls required to close that gap. translated_title: 面向AI辅助代码演进的EVM锚定溯源：一项冒烟规模部署报告
translated_abstract: 我们报告了一项针对AI辅助代码生成所产生的状态流的EVM锚定溯源框架的冒烟规模部署。该系统由两部分组成：codebase-state-manager，一个开源的模型上下文协议（MCP）服务器（MIT许可，v0.2.1版本），可向任何兼容MCP的助手暴露代码库状态、转换和奖励操作；以及CodebaseStateRegistry，一个部署在Base Sepolia测试网上的Solidity合约，用于发出每个状态的承诺事件。数据载荷被固定到星际文件系统（IPFS）上，并通过一个可通过重放合约事件来重新同步的可重建SQLite镜像进行索引。我们精确界定了锚定能证明什么和不能证明什么（提交者密钥的存在性、排序性以及不可否认性；绝不证明真实性或防止伪造），并概述了弥合这一差距所需的正交供应链控制措施。在本地Anvil模拟器上作者生成的合成工作负载下，中位数提交……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文报告了一个面向AI辅助代码演进的EVM锚定溯源系统的冒烟规模部署，通过MCP服务器、Solidity合约、IPFS固定与可重建的SQLite索引，为AI生成的代码状态流提供链上存在性、排序性和不可否认性证明，并明确界定了锚定不证明真实性的边界。
en_tdlr: The paper reports a smoke-scale deployment of an EVM-anchored provenance framework for AI-assisted code evolution, combining an MCP server, a Solidity registry contract on Base Sepolia, IPFS pinning, and a rebuildable SQLite index to attest code-state existence, ordering, and non-equivocation—while explicitly delimiting that anchoring never attests truthfulness.
